rows.grounds: locative plural of compound referring to womb-mechanisms
past passive participle describing afflicted beings

items.question: By what count and in what setting are certain beings held to suffer torment according to this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified here.
That count applies to thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings within those womb-diagrams are said to be tormented.
items.inference: Torment is ascribed to beings located in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings remains unspecified.
The nature of the torment is not indicated here.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
